_help.about: Boss behaviour pools (Mike, 9 Oct: every boss has 'a group of different behaviors that each boss can cycle through on RNG level', so the player can never pin down its algorithm). Claude (chat) wrote the structure and every number below as first guesses; Mike tunes by playing. Wired 9 Oct (Claude Code, queue 65, §FM.1; BossPool, BossState, Boss; check tools/boss_pool_check.gd): rule, pools and 'rounds', the boss's built behaviour wrapped, so a pool of 'rounds' alone plays exactly as before. The desert's four new states and camouflage: wired 9 Oct (Claude Code, queue 66, §FM.2; see _help.desert and _help.camouflage; check tools/boss_snake_check.gd).
_help.rule: draw: a weighted random pick from the boss's own states, never a fixed sequence. repeat_gap: the same state is not picked twice running unless it is the only one. live_rng: the draw is not seeded from the game seed, so loading a save does not replay it (the dungeon itself is seeded, §FK.2). dwell_s [min, max]: how long a picked state lasts before the next draw, unless something ends it (you light its room, it strikes, you leave). never_breaks: a state may never break a §EY rule: a relit room stays safe, the boss never blocks the exit, the torch hold, the wind-up and the strike tell always hold, and a hit is one of three (§FD). Built (Claude Code, queue 65; BossPool, Boss): draw weighted; repeat_gap leaves the last that many draws out (1: never twice running) unless nothing else may come; a state whose needs don't hold now (BossState.can_enter) is left out of that draw. live_rng true: the pool's own dice; false: seeded from the game seed and the boss. dwell_s in seconds, a single number is itself. A state also ends when it ends itself or one of the rule's own moments begins (Boss.RULE_MOMENTS: the chase, the torch hold, the strike, leaving the light, a fire pot, you taken, the last light), and the pool is asked only once the boss is free of them, its strike ready and out of its tunnels. never_breaks as built, whatever a state does: relit_room_stays_safe, a room lit round a state or one it walks into ends it and the boss leaves for the dark as built; never_blocks_exit, a state that keeps it still on the way out (the pieces marked exit, the flight up and the landing, and 2 m round a doorway onto them or out) for Boss.EXIT_WAIT_S (0.5 s) is over, and the boss goes off it on its rounds before the next draw; torch_hold_holds and wind_up_and_tell_always_play, a state strikes only by Boss.begin_strike, the strike as built (your lit torch holds it first, then its wind-up with its tell), and no state ends mid-strike; a_hit_is_one_of_three, a strike lands one hit in harm.json as built.
_help.pools: One entry per boss id from bosses.json → bosses. 'rounds' is the boss's built behaviour (queue 49), so a boss with only that entry plays exactly as it does now. Which states other bosses share is NOT locked (§FM.1): the names lurk_threshold, observe, withdraw and strike are Claude's proposal, kept out of the data until Mike agrees. Built (Claude Code, queue 65): a state's code is found by its id, scripts/crawler/boss_states/<id>.gd (extends BossState: enter, tick, exit), or registered in code (BossPool.register); an id no code registers is skipped with one warning, never a crash, and a boss with no entry here, or none of its states found, plays its rounds. Each state's entry is its own numbers (BossState.def).
_help.desert: The snake (§FM.2). freeze_watched: you look at it from far off and it goes still, a little more camouflaged than now and never invisible (invisibility is saved for another boss); this one is the snake's own, not shared. doorway_watch: it sits in a doorway of an unlit room and watches you. observe_then_behind: it studies you out of your light for a while, then goes round and takes you from behind. coil_ambush: you hear it and turn, and it is already coiled with its wind-up begun (the jump scare); a hit is still only hit 1 of three. Built 9 Oct (Claude Code, queue 66; scripts/crawler/boss_states/<id>.gd, BossStalk, Boss; check tools/boss_snake_check.gd). freeze_watched (needs watched): all of it at least from_m[0] from you (its nearest part, its head included), its head or a length of its body inside look_deg of your view axis within from_m[1], seen there in your torch's light, a fire's light on the floor, or your half-dark sight; never in a lit room or stretch, on the way out or in its tunnels. Besides its turn in the draw, it may cut in the moment you first catch sight of it, weighed against the state in charge by their two weights, so sometimes it freezes and sometimes not. Frozen it stops dead and lies still, silent, its sprites easing toward the stone (camouflage); it ends when you come within close_m of any of it (its nearest part, as from_m counts), after you have looked away look_away_s, or at its dwell, and the pool draws the next with no tell. doorway_watch: the nearest doorway (by its own dark way) of an unlit room it can reach that you are not in, never onto the way out, into the hearth room, off its floor or through a seal (the stair down to floor two, §FM.6, sealed until floor one is lit); it goes there through its dark and lies just inside the room, still, its head in the gap and turned toward you (head_m: how far its front, head and snout, reaches from the room's side of the wall; 0.8 puts its head's middle 0.17 m past the wall's middle and its snout just out of the far side). Its room lit: it leaves for the dark (the boss rule); a light caught across its way there: it goes round by another dark way, or the watch is over; you in that room: the watch is over; you within its strike's reach, on its way or at its doorway: the strike as built. observe_then_behind and coil_ambush come only with you on its own floor (not down the stair, §FM.6) and not while it has let you go (let_go_s, below); a light caught across their way, they find another through the dark. observe_then_behind: it finds you through its dark, then for observe_s keeps to the middle of observe_m from you, outside your torch's circle (where your lit torch's light on the floor passes the chase's cap, about 7 m), backing away if you come at it (inside observe_m for 1.5 s it is found out: over, or the strike if you are within its reach), and loses you after gives_up.out_of_sight_s out of its senses; then it goes round behind you, coming on only while it is behind you (more than 90 degrees from where you look) and holding still while you look its way, for at most behind_s (Claude Code's first guess, 12 s), and strikes with the strike as built. coil_ambush: it goes round to a spot lies_coiled_behind_m behind you (never by a way that passes you) and curls up there, sliding after you as you move on (its tell sounding) and silent while you stand; its dwell counts from when it first lay down. Turn toward it (its head within turn_deg of where you look: Claude Code's first guess, 50, about where it comes into the frame) and its wind-up begins on that very tick; walk on, and at its dwell it lets you go (let_go_s: Claude Code's first guess, 8 s, in which its rounds don't take you up by sight or hearing and neither it nor observe_then_behind may come back for you). Your torch (torch_delay, the hold kept): the time observe_then_behind and coil_ambush have spent stalking you beyond your torch's bright circle (torch_delay.hang_m), your torch lit, counts toward torch_delay.hang_s, in all, as the hold does; so once they have stalked you that long they strike without a further hold, and turned on sooner your flame holds the ambush first (reared at its edge, hissing its warning), then it strikes. Every strike is Boss.begin_strike's: its tell and wind-up first, one hit in harm.json.
_help.camouflage: blend: how far its look moves toward the stone it lies on (0 is as built, 1 would be gone). max_blend: never above this, so it is never invisible. Texture and value only, no transparency. Built 9 Oct (Claude Code, queue 66; Boss.camo, BossBody.set_camouflage, FigureSprite.set_blend, shaders/figure_sprite.gdshader): while freeze_watched holds it, every one of its sprites' colours eases toward the ruin's own stone (as fast as would take it to max_blend in 0.8 s: half a second to 0.3) (masonry.json's style tint, RuinStyle) by freeze_watched.blend (else this blend), each cell of it straying lighter or darker by that stone's own spread, so it takes on the floor's tone and grain; never past max_blend; it eases back off when the freeze ends. The alpha is never touched, so its outline stays whole.
_help.check: headless: over 200 draws the sequence is not a fixed order, never repeats a state twice running, and every state is drawn at least once. Built: tools/boss_pool_check.gd (queue 65).
